claim.quote: We report on a new measurement of the beam transverse single spin asymmetry in electron-proton elastic scattering,

name: A4: beam transverse single-spin asymmetry from 315 MeV to 1.5 GeV

summary.plain: A4 measured how a transversely polarised electron beam scatters differently from protons at five beam energies, which probes the exchange of two photons between electron and proton. The data point to contributions from excited states of the proton that no current calculation reproduces.
summary.technical: Beam transverse single-spin asymmetry A_perp^ep at five beam energies from 315.1 to 1508.4 MeV (30 < theta < 40 degrees, Q^2 = 0.032, 0.057, 0.082, 0.218, 0.613 (GeV/c)^2): significant inelastic contributions to the two-photon-exchange amplitude at low Q^2; no theoretical calculation reproduces the result.

title: Study of Two-Photon Exchange via the Beam Transverse Single Spin Asymmetry in Electron-Proton Elastic Scattering at Forward Angles over a Wide Energy Range
why_it_matters: A wide-energy benchmark for calculations of two-photon exchange, a quantum correction that limits the interpretation of precision electron-scattering measurements.
